title: Earthquake with 4.3 magnitude rocks San Francisco Bay Area
summary: More than 22,000 people report feeling early-morning quake, which occurred east-south-east of Berkeley An earthquake with a magnitude of 4.3 rocked the San Francisco Bay Area early on Monday, waking up many people. The earthquake was just east-south-east of Berkeley, the United States Geological survey said, and more than 22,000 people said they felt it. Continue reading...

title: Democrats silent as Republicans galvanised after Charlie Kirk memorial
summary: Democrats trod carefully in responding to event attended by nearly 100,000 that blended politics with religion Democrats maintained a wary silence on Monday as Donald Trump’s Republican party appeared galvanised by a memorial service for the late rightwing activist Charlie Kirk that was part religious revival, part political rally. Nearly 100,000 people filled an American football stadium and overflow arena in Glendale, Arizona, on Sunday to pay tribute to Kirk, according to his his organisation Turning Point USA. The 31-year-old staunch Trump ally was shot dead on 10 September. Continue reading...
